rows.transcript_1:
Hello! How are you feeling right now? Happy, sad, angry, excited, worried?

Notice where you feel it in your body. Notice what thoughts are connected to that feeling. Take a deep breath.

Thank yourself for taking the time to check in with your feelings and thoughts!
rows.transcript_2:
Hai! Bagaimana perasaan anda sekarang? Gembira, sedih, marah, teruja, risau?

Perhatikan dimanakah perasaan itu muncul di tubuh badan anda. Perhatikan juga fikiran yang datang bersama perasaan itu. Tarik nafas dengan dalam dan hembus nafas perlahan-lahan.

Ucapkan terima kasih kepada diri sendiri kerana meluangkan masa untuk menyemak perasaan dan fikiran anda.

text_1_facilitator.eng: Today’s skill is about encouraging your child to eat nutritious food and practise healthy eating habits. 🍚

text_2.eng:
Children are exposed to lots of different food in their lives. 🎂☕

Some are good for children’s development, while others are not. 🍅

Did you know that children can be trained at home to eat balanced and nutritious meals in moderate amounts, especially in the early years? 🍞

With your support, children can practise healthy eating habits from a young age. 💛

text_1_facilitator.eng:
Teaching your child healthy eating habits from a young age will help them make healthy choices as they grow older. 💙😃🍚

4️⃣ Here are four tips you can use to support your child with healthy eating:

rows.text_1_facilitator:
Teaching your child healthy eating habits from a young age will help them make healthy choices as they grow older. 💙😃🍚

4️⃣ Here are four tips you can use to support your child with healthy eating:

section_1_text.eng:
Allow your child to enjoy a variety of food in moderation. Every day, make sure they have:
🍚 2-3 servings of carbohydrates
1 serving: 2 spoons of rice or 2 slices of bread
🍅 3-4 servings of fruits and vegetables 
1 serving: ½ cup of vegetables or 1 medium-sized fruit
💚 1-2 servings of dairy products and protein
1 serving: 1 chicken thigh, 2 eggs or 1 glass of milk
🚩 Just a little bit of oil, fat, processed sugar, and salt

section_2_text.eng:
🌷 Sometimes, your child may start whining for unhealthy food choices. Take a deep breath and stay calm. 
➡️ Try redirecting your child’s attention to healthier food options. Ignore their demanding behaviour if they continue. 
🏅 Praise or reward your child for choosing healthy foods.

section_3_text.eng:
👂 Listen to your child when they say they are hungry or full. 
💡 Depending on your child’s activities for the day, your child may require less or more food. 
💚 If your child always seems hungry or full, a doctor can help to figure out why.
☕ your child will also observe and learn from the eating habits of people around them. Make healthy food choices as a family to teach your child to do the same.

section_4_text.eng:
💙 Preparing food with love is important for your child - and so is keeping it clean!
✨ Wash your hands before handling food or feeding your child. 
💡 Wash fresh food items before cooking them.
☀️ Hot weather makes food spoil quickly. It is best to store food in airtight containers or the fridge so they stay fresh. 
⭐ Keep the kitchen, fridge, cutlery, and table tops clean from dust, insects, and house lizards.
